import urllib.request,json,datetime
with urllib.request.urlopen('http://127.0.0.1:17448/api/ai-profiles',timeout=5) as r:d=json.load(r)
out={'at':datetime.datetime.now().isoformat(timespec='seconds'),'chatgptProfiles':[]}
for x in d.get('aiProfiles',[]):
 if x.get('provider')!='chatgpt':continue
 out['chatgptProfiles'].append({'debugPort':x.get('debugPort'),'enabled':x.get('enabled'),'mode':x.get('launchMode'),'workerConnected':x.get('workerConnected')})
print(json.dumps(out,ensure_ascii=True)[:2000])
